rules.description: Applicant must have a National Insurance number
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a National Insurance number to check your record. Apply for one if you do not have one.

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to have a National Insurance record

rules.description: Applicant must be able to verify identity through GOV.UK Sign In
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to verify your identity to access your NI record online. Request a printed statement instead.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has paid NI contributions in Isle of Man and reaches State Pension age after 5 April 2016
edge_cases.action: Isle of Man contributions will not appear in your online record. Email nationalinsurance.itd@gov.im for your Isle of Man contribution history.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has gaps but cannot pay voluntary contributions online
edge_cases.action: Call the Future Pension Centre on 0800 731 0175 to arrange payment by other means.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is within 12 months of State Pension age with complex contribution history
edge_cases.action: Speak to a pension specialist before paying voluntary contributions. You may not benefit or may need specific advice. Contact Future Pension Centre.

edge_cases.description: Applicant wants information about current or previous tax year
edge_cases.action: Current and previous tax year information is not available online. Request a printed statement specifying the years you need.
